title: Johnnie Verbeck
transcription:
Johnnie Verbeck

There was a little Dutchman,
his name was Johnnie Verbeck.
He was a dealer in sausages
and sauerkraut and spec.
He made the finest sausages
that ever you did see.
But one day he invented
a wonderful sausage machine.

Chorus:
Oh, Mister Johnnie Verbeck,
How could you be so mean?
I told you you'd be sorry
For inventing that machine.
Now all the neighbors' cats and dogs
Will never more be seen,
They'll all be ground to sausages
In Johnnie Verbeck's machine.

One day a little fat boy
came walking in the store,
He bought a pound of sausage
and piled them on the floor;
Then he began to whistle
and he whistled up a tune,
And all the little sausages
went dancing around the room.

Chorus

One day the machine got busted,
the blamed thing wouldn't go,
So Johnnie Verbeck, he climbed inside
to see what made it so.
His wife, she had a nightmare
and walking in her sleep,
She gave the crank and awful yank and
Johnnie Verbeck was meat.

Chorus
